Subject Code: HMC 110                     Subject: Communication Skills
Time : 1 ½ Hours                                               Maximum Marks : 30
Note: Note: Q.1 is compulsory. Attempt any two parts from Q2 and Q3. Read the
questions carefully before writing the answers. For all questions of 5 marks (except
2a) give a brief Introduction and then use two paragraphs to write the answer. There
is no word limit but use time wisely to attempt all questions as per the instructions

Q1 Explain the following in three points :                         (2.5*4)     CO
                                                                              Mapping
     (e)    Role of Feedback in Communication Cycle                             CO1
     (f)    Importance of Non Verbal Communication                              CO2
     (g)    Purpose of a group Discussions                                      CO1
     (h)    Points to remember while making a Call                              CO2

Q2          Attempt any TWO from the following:                     (5,5)      CO
                                                                              Mapping

     (a)Rearrange the Following into a meaningful paragraph. Only             CO1
     mention the sequence in the answer sheet.

         A. The US market will continue to be the dominant one in the foreseeable
             future. The rupee could become even stronger.
         B. A greater recourse to hedging as well as striving for multi-currency
             revenue streams automatically suggests itself.
         C. Already one company, TCS, by resorting to these methods extensively
             has turned in an above - average performance during the first quarter.
         D. Most IT companies have been grappling with more mundane problems
             such as a high level of attrition amidst rising wage costs and inability to
             secure the right type and number of American visas.
         E. The BPO industry and many medium-sized software exporters are
             reportedly operating on thin margins.
     (b) The 7Cs are the basis of effective and meaningful                     CO1
     communication. In the light of this statement discuss how 7Cs
     can contribute in making an individual’s communication style
     effective and formal.

     (c) Body language has a language of its own. Justify this                 CO1
     statement. Discuss the significance of Kinesics for a working
     professional with relevant examples

Q3 Attempt any TWO from the following:                     (5,5) CO Mapping
   (a) Barriers will always be there in any communication          CO2
   process but our efforts can make the situation better. Do you
   agree with this statement? Differentiate between Emotional
   Outburst and Communication Selectivity as barriers leading
   to unsuccessful communication.

    (b) Delivering a presentation is both easy and difficult at the         CO2
    same time. Give your opinion regarding this statement.
    According to you, what should a presenter keep in mind while
    delivering a Presentation?

    (c) Writing is easy when we write for ourselves but challenging         CO2
    when we know we are writing for others. Keeping this
    statement in mind discuss the formal and informal writing styles.
